parent_ledger_audit.six_physical_families_basis: The parent count and decision narrative identify six mandatory physical-state families: the six IDs reproduced below. Velocity boundary conditions and model/numerical controls are separate interface/configuration families.
parent_ledger_audit.metadata_discrepancy: The parent JSON also sets authorial_required=true on velocity_boundary_conditions and model_and_numerical_controls despite its separate count of six authorial physical-state families. This adjudication preserves the exact six physical families and treats those two booleans as an unresolved parent-ledger classification inconsistency; it does not promote numerical controls or the .bcs interface to WORLD_HISTORY physical state.

parent_input_families.authority_status: Land field is authorial synthetic; no complete surface field.
parent_input_families.candidate_producer: Existing land topography payload; ocean values need governed source/initialization.

parent_input_families.physical_meaning: Surface heat-flow field supporting the selected thermal/lithospheric structure.
parent_input_families.authority_status: No synthetic heat-flow field or method bound; Earth observations are not transferable by default.
parent_input_families.candidate_producer: OrbData5 may interpolate/derive from chosen datasets and assumptions.

parent_input_families.units: m in FEG examples; source datasets can use other units
parent_input_families.authority_status: No physical thickness values; province/crust classes do not imply thickness or rock composition.
parent_input_families.candidate_producer: OrbData5 from selected input datasets/assumptions or authorial field

parent_input_families.physical_meaning: Thickness of mantle lithosphere beneath crust.
parent_input_families.candidate_producer: OrbData5 from chosen local-isostasy/geotherm or seismic source, or authorial field

parent_input_families.physical_meaning: Two-layer thin-shell thermal/compositional/density structure that influences strength and force balance; literature does not establish a required standalone density raster in every FEG.

parent_input_families.support: mesh node and layer plus global material parameters; T0

parent_input_families.shellset_name: SHELLS frictional-plastic and dislocation-creep law parameters
parent_input_families.physical_meaning: Built-in low-temperature frictional rheology and thermally activated dislocation-creep laws for crust and mantle lithosphere.
parent_input_families.units: Parameter-specific; friction coefficient dimensionless; creep law depends on law form
parent_input_families.support: Global and grouped continuum elements; long-term quasi-static constitutive model
parent_input_families.authority_status: No material family/parameter authority. Exact version-specific names/ranges/defaults UNKNOWN.
parent_input_families.candidate_producer: SHELLS implements laws; ARCANA binds only approved specialist parameters

dependency_graph.condition: OrbData local-isostasy mode may calculate thickness from elevation with heat-flow/geotherm, density/material assumptions; not a universal identity.
Same conditional OrbData local-isostasy/geotherm calculation; actual independent seismic layer data is another input path.
Heat flow is a thermal boundary constraint in selected OrbData workflows; does not uniquely determine a 3-D geotherm without conductivity, boundary conditions and model assumptions.
Fourier conduction q=-k∇T permits heat-flow derivation given temperature gradient and conductivity; ARCANA lacks both complete field and material conductivity authority. Adapter required.
Composition may constrain density through a chosen equation of state/material table; no ARCANA material law or density mapping is authorized.
OrbData derives structure only under selected local-isostasy/geotherm assumptions or receives seismic thickness data; source/parameters are not bound.
Constitutive law parameters affect mechanical response; they do not generate initial thermal/compositional fields.

GWB half-space cooling needs ridge coordinates and spreading velocity; rotations could contribute velocity after ridge/process semantics are authorized, but do not identify ridges, age or crustal type.
R6 crust_class is assigned from land/ocean/coast categories and is not sufficient authority for physical lithology/material properties.

independent_authorial_primitives.physical_meaning: Complete T0 surface elevation field, with existing canonical land elevation retained and ocean surface support explicitly initialized or generated from an authorized parameterization.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_parameterization: AUTHORIAL_FIELD with a generative low-dimensional design; existing land field is canonical, unresolved ocean portion must not be painted cell by cell absent need.
independent_authorial_primitives.dependencies: Not derivable from current plate IDs/rotations. Isostatic compatibility may constrain it jointly with thickness and density, but does not uniquely determine it.
independent_authorial_primitives.constraints: Finite supported field, consistent datum and chosen physical structure; no numerical range added here.
independent_authorial_primitives.valid_domain: Complete modeled surface with explicit supported/unknown status; units and datum must be consistent.
independent_authorial_primitives.conservation_relationship: No standalone conservation law uniquely fixes topography; selected isostatic mode must reconcile topography with layer mass/density without silently changing canonical land elevations.
independent_authorial_primitives.neighboring_field_relationship: Must be jointly compatible with crust/lithosphere thickness, material density and thermal structure if local isostasy is used.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_smoothness_or_discontinuity: No global smoothness assumption authorized; coast and tectonic relief may have physically justified transitions, requiring a documented representation.
independent_authorial_primitives.plate_ocean_dependency: Must cover ocean and land; no uniform-by-plate rule established.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_heterogeneity_required: Yes, existing land field is heterogeneous; ocean support still unknown.
independent_authorial_primitives.consumer: OrbData5/SHELLS; GWB can assign configured feature topography but does not infer realistic ocean bathymetry.
independent_authorial_primitives.uncertainty: Synthetic land portion already carries authorial uncertainty; ocean support remains UNKNOWN.

independent_authorial_primitives.physical_meaning: Physical crust/lithosphere class semantics and material property mapping (composition/density/thermal properties) needed to distinguish material behavior.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_parameterization: PER_CRUSTAL_OR_MATERIAL_CLASS, then SPECIALIST_GENERATED_FIELD; feature-level exceptions only when authorized.
independent_authorial_primitives.dependencies: Independent of elevation and temperature; may constrain density, heat transport and rheology through a chosen material model.
independent_authorial_primitives.constraints: Classes must represent physical materials, not simply land/ocean/province labels; properties must be mutually consistent and source-version compatible.
independent_authorial_primitives.valid_domain: Explicit finite material class registry and properties with dimensions/units required by selected specialist.
independent_authorial_primitives.conservation_relationship: Material mixture/density mapping must obey the selected mass/composition formulation; no mixing law selected here.
independent_authorial_primitives.neighboring_field_relationship: Property contrasts must be compatible with thermal conductivity, density, thickness and rheology mappings.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_smoothness_or_discontinuity: Class boundaries may be discontinuous at authorized geological features; no smoothing or interpolation policy selected.
independent_authorial_primitives.plate_ocean_dependency: May vary by oceanic/continental crust and plate/feature only where physically authorized; current land/ocean-derived class is insufficient.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_heterogeneity_required: At least class-aware heterogeneity if distinct physical lithologies are selected; exact heterogeneity unresolved.
independent_authorial_primitives.consumer: GWB composition assignment, OrbData5/SHELLS structure and rheology grouping via adapters.
independent_authorial_primitives.uncertainty: Poorly constrained in a synthetic world.

independent_authorial_primitives.physical_meaning: Authorized T0 thermal model family and its driving feature parameters (for example thermal boundary conditions, material thermal properties, and—if an oceanic half-space cooling model is chosen—ridge geometry, spreading velocity and plate-age/history information).
independent_authorial_primitives.units: Model-specific; temperature K, depth m, heat flux W m^-2, conductivity W m^-1 K^-1, velocity m yr^-1 where relevant
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_parameterization: PER_MATERIAL_CLASS or PER_TECTONIC_FEATURE, with SPECIALIST_GENERATED_FIELD; no full-grid authorship as default.
independent_authorial_primitives.dependencies: Requires material properties and any tectonic feature semantics used by the selected model. GWB cannot infer ridge/subduction features or authorize their meanings.
independent_authorial_primitives.constraints: Thermal profile and derived heat flux must be mutually consistent with conductivity, layer geometry and model boundary conditions; no values or feature classes chosen.
independent_authorial_primitives.valid_domain: Model-supported temperature/depth domain and physically admissible boundary conditions; exact ranges depend on pinned model and are deferred.
independent_authorial_primitives.conservation_relationship: Thermal energy/heat flux relationships must follow the selected thermal model; no energy source/sink budget is specified in this stage.
independent_authorial_primitives.neighboring_field_relationship: Coupled to material conductivity, density, layer thickness and surface topography/heat-flow conditions.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_smoothness_or_discontinuity: Use model-generated profiles and feature transitions; discontinuities only at authorized material/process boundaries.
independent_authorial_primitives.plate_ocean_dependency: Oceanic cooling models may require ridge position, spreading/plate velocity and age; continental thermal models require their own authored constraints.
independent_authorial_primitives.spatial_heterogeneity_required: Specialist-generated by class/feature; not assumed uniform across all 12 plates.
independent_authorial_primitives.consumer: GWB and/or OrbData5, then ShellSet FEG adapter.
independent_authorial_primitives.uncertainty: High; thermal-model and feature alternatives are plausible.

rheology_parameter_classification.specialist_law: SHELLS built-in low-temperature frictional-plastic law and crust/mantle dislocation-creep flow laws.
rheology_parameter_classification.parameterization: Begin with globally configured specialist parameters; optional FEG element-group variation only if authorized material classes justify it. Per-plate values are not justified by current state.
rheology_parameter_classification.classification: PHYSICAL_MODEL_PARAMETER, not world-history initial-state field; numerical solver tolerances remain ENGINE_CONFIGURATION_ONLY.
rheology_parameter_classification.defaults: Do not accept Earth-calibrated/example defaults. Exact parameter defaults/ranges need pinned SHELLS source audit; no values selected.
rheology_parameter_classification.evidence: ShellSet paper §§2.2, 3.1 identifies four frictional inputs, optional lower fault friction, nine crust/mantle creep parameters, and only general parameter consistency checks.

derived_fields.limitations: Requires complete temperature gradient, conductivity/material authority, surface normal and unit/frame mapping. Current R6 T0 cannot supply it.
derived_fields.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate temperature-gradient and conductivity uncertainty through the derived flux; adapter records method and source hashes.
derived_fields.resolution_relationship: Derive on the thermal/material support, then project conservatively or with measured interpolation error to the FEG nodes.

derived_fields.from: elevation, thermal/heat-flow model, density/material assumptions or chosen seismic-thickness provider
derived_fields.method: OrbData local-isostasy and steady-state-geotherm workflow; alternate seismic layer-thickness input route
derived_fields.limitations: Not a universal field identity; requires selecting source/mode/assumptions and documenting uncertainty.
derived_fields.uncertainty_propagation: Carry input elevation, thermal, density and model-choice uncertainty through OrbData outputs.
derived_fields.resolution_relationship: Generate on FEG nodes from the chosen inputs; input data projection and node mapping must be recorded.

derived_fields.from: elevation, thermal/heat-flow model, density/material assumptions or chosen seismic-thickness provider
derived_fields.limitations: Same joint dependency; exact fields and parser contract must be pinned before execution.
derived_fields.uncertainty_propagation: Carry input elevation, thermal, density and model-choice uncertainty through OrbData outputs.
derived_fields.resolution_relationship: Generate on FEG nodes from the chosen inputs; input data projection and node mapping must be recorded.

derived_fields.from: authorized physical class/features and GWB configuration
derived_fields.limitations: GWB requires feature type/geometry, depth support, model parameters, composition labels and thermal parameters. It does not authorize subduction/ridge or material classes; requires grid/field adapter for ShellSet.
derived_fields.uncertainty_propagation: Record primitive, model/version and parameter-set provenance; carry scenario/input uncertainty through generated fields.
derived_fields.resolution_relationship: GWB output grid resolution follows supplied domain/grid; re-sampling to FEG needs documented method/error.

derived_fields.from: material composition/class plus selected material/thermal relationship
derived_fields.method: OrbData/SHELLS model parameterization or separately authorized material model
derived_fields.limitations: GWB composition output is not itself density; no equation-of-state/material table is bound.
derived_fields.uncertainty_propagation: Unknown until a property law/table is authorized.
derived_fields.resolution_relationship: Must use the same material classes and support as temperature/thickness fields; mapping not yet defined.

can_generate: nodal structure fields from selected sources/assumptions
specialist_materializers.output_authority: SPECIALIST_DERIVED_INPUT only; provenance must carry source fields, assumptions and transform.
specialist_materializers.uncertainty_propagation: Carry upstream measurement/initialization uncertainty and selected-method uncertainty; output lineage must record input hashes and settings.
specialist_materializers.resolution_relationship: Writes to the FEG nodal support; any source-grid interpolation to nodes must be recorded.
specialist_materializers.reproducibility: Pin OrbData version, input data hashes and configuration; repeatability not verified in this stage.

specialist_materializers.determinism: Expected repeatable for pinned tool/version and identical complete inputs; not runtime-verified here.
specialist_materializers.adapter: Convert output grid/fields to the ShellSet FEG mesh while recording interpolation and field provenance.
specialist_materializers.uncertainty_propagation: Propagate input feature/parameter ensembles as corresponding generated-field ensembles; model uncertainty needs separate treatment.
specialist_materializers.resolution_relationship: Output follows specified GWB domain and grid; ShellSet FEG resampling is an explicit adapter step.
specialist_materializers.reproducibility: Pin GWB version, world description, source hashes and parameters; deterministic behavior not runtime-verified here.
specialist_materializers.cannot_authorize: Feature types, composition labels, spreading/ridge history, subduction/slab or boundary processes.

can_generate: plate-side kinematic velocities from authorized rotations/topology
cannot_generate: elevation, temperature, heat-flow, thickness, composition, density or rheology
specialist_materializers.status: No reduction of the six physical input families; values may later inform an authorized thermal/ridge model or BC adapter.

spatial_parameterization.elevation: Existing authorial land field plus explicit supported/unknown ocean domain; a class/feature-based generative representation is preferable to 64,800 cell-by-cell values.
spatial_parameterization.thermal_state_and_heat_flow: SPECIALIST_GENERATED_FIELD, ideally per authorized material/tectonic feature; if oceanic half-space cooling is selected, GWB needs ridge coordinates, spreading velocity and depth support; plate age/history authority absent.
spatial_parameterization.crust_and_mantle_thickness: SPECIALIST_GENERATED_FIELD from OrbData selected model or provider fields; not automatically uniform per plate.
spatial_parameterization.material_class_and_properties: PER_MATERIAL_CLASS minimum candidate; per-plate variation only if plate material semantics are physically authored.
spatial_parameterization.rheology: Global or per justified material/element group; no per-cell parameter field requirement established.

boundary_process_dependencies.ridge_or_spreading: Required by GWB half-space cooling option; ARCANA has kinematic demand but no boundary-process classes or ridge geometry authority.
boundary_process_dependencies.subduction: Required only for a GWB subducting-plate/slab feature; requires trench coordinates, dip-side/dip point, slab segment geometry, thickness/angle and selected thermal/composition models. ARCANA has no such authority.
boundary_process_dependencies.collision_rift_transform_distributed_def: Not proven mandatory for all six fields; required if chosen feature/material model encodes them. Do not infer from convergence/divergence/shear.

crustal_type_dependencies.canonical_field: crust_class codes OCEANIC/CONTINENTAL/TRANSITIONAL exist in the materialization manifest.
crustal_type_dependencies.observed_semantics: Repository validation binds non-coastal land to CONTINENTAL, ocean to OCEANIC, coast to TRANSITIONAL.
crustal_type_dependencies.sufficiency: Insufficient as physical crust/material authority because it is derived from land/ocean support and does not encode lithology, thickness, age or mechanical material properties.
crustal_type_dependencies.no_inference: Do not use land/ocean alone as the physical material classification.

ensemble_candidates.reason: Synthetic physical composition/density/material mapping is unobserved and may support multiple plausible designs.
Multiple thermal model families and feature histories can yield distinct T0 fields; downstream sensitivity should preserve that uncertainty.

ensemble_candidates.recommendation: ENSEMBLE_RECOMMENDED for later sensitivity, not now
ensemble_candidates.reason: No canonical constraints select the physical material law parameters; parameter sensitivity is an appropriate later experiment after ranges are scientifically constrained.

irreducible_gaps.resolution: Targeted authorial classification contract; the existing class field is land/ocean-derived and insufficient.

irreducible_gaps.blocks: GWB ridge/half-space and subduction/slab feature initialization if those models are selected; also fault/slab mechanics labels.
irreducible_gaps.resolution: Only authorize classes actually needed by the selected initializer; do not classify from kinematics alone.

irreducible_gaps.blocks: Composition-to-density/equation-of-state mapping and heat-flow conversion beyond Fourier formula; no material table or complete temperature input.
irreducible_gaps.resolution: Choose an established model/provider and bind its required physical parameters and provenance.

Fault/slab process semantics would determine which node velocities are prescribed
shellset_interface_dependencies.not_solved: No `.bcs` frame, node-selection, velocity constraint, or FE mesh adapter decision is made in this stage.

junction_status.note: No junction law or mechanics added; whether generated state and connected FEG are sufficient remains a runtime/source-qualification question.

patch_operator_disposition.condition: Conditional on later specialist connected-domain proof; no custom ARCANA scientific physics is required by this adjudication.

counts.counting_note: Counts are parent-family counts, not scalar parameter counts. Elevation is only partially canonical. Crust and mantle thicknesses are jointly derivable by OrbData only under a selected documented method and inputs. Heat flow can follow Fourier conduction from an authorized thermal field and conductivity. GWB materializes configured fields, not their authority. Rheology is an authorial constitutive-model parameter family, excluded from WORLD_HISTORY state. Classification/material-map gaps mean this is a reduced candidate vector, not ready for parameter constraint adjudication.

Resolve only these semantic authorities; do not select parameter values or run engines.
